question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **REBELLIOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disobedient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rebellious"** refers to a person or behavior that resists authority, control, or convention. It signifies defiance and a refusal to conform. (विद्रोही)
 
 
• **Example: **The rebellious teenager refused to follow the school rules and often challenged the teachers.
 
 
• **"Disobedient" **means refusing to obey rules or someone in authority, which aligns closely with the meaning of "rebellious." (आज्ञा न मानने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The disobedient child ignored his parents' instructions and continued playing outside.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"rebellious"** is **"disobedient"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disobedient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Submissive** (आज्ञाकारी): Ready to conform to the authority or will of others; meekly obedient or passive.
 
 
• **Example: **The submissive employee always followed instructions without questioning.
 
 

 
• **Obedient** (आज्ञाकारी): Willing to comply with orders or requests; dutiful.
 
 
• **Example: **The obedient dog followed every command its owner gave.
 
 

 
• **Agreeable** (सहमत): Willing to agree or consent; pleasant and easy to get along with.
 
 
• **Example: **She is an agreeable person who enjoys making others feel comfortable.
